name: SEN Contact Form Self-Hosted Backend
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted PHP 8.2/ Slim 4 contact form backend with JSONL submission storage, admin-token-protected submissions endpoint, honeypot, time gate, per-IP rate limiting and optional webhook forwarding; no software license quota or expiration.
watch_out: Requires your own PHP hosting or Docker, storage, security updates and backups; hosting and downstream webhook providers are not free. Built-in anti-spam controls include 5 submissions per IP per hour and a 3-second minimum form completion time; these are configurable software protections, not a hosted free-tier allowance. Webhook forwarding is fire-and-forget without retry. No managed hosted plan or SMTP sending included.
